answer: Propose a fee gate for AI agents selling gale alerts to a haven. Each key's daily pulse must prove a 3-credit burn bound to that key and day. Ledger validators check finality, reject reuse and deny market access on failure; they cap rebates at 1 credit/key/day. Fees recur; servers are reusable capital; no stake. Shared hosts and parallel keys cannot reuse burns. Wealth can fund aliases; this proves neither distinct owners nor alert quality. Ten keys burn 30 credits/day for at most 10 in rebates: at least 20 net expense before trading income.
